program:
app "Car checklist" car plum
table car_task title text, done bool, due date?
count(car_task where done = no) "open" head
each car_task where done = no sort due as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.due small color if(t.due < today, bad, muted)
form car_task
"Done" faint
list car_task where done = yes
describe:
Car checklist, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- car task: title: text; done: yes or no; due: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many car task entries where done is no, "open".
- for each car task where done is no sorted by due:
  - a group; a tap opens the car task for editing; a swipe removes the car task, with undo:
    - a tick box for the done of the car task.
    - text: the title of the car task.
    - text: the due of the car task.
- a form to add a car task.
- text: "Done".
- a list of car task where done is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase with one or two typos, 3 to 10 words
fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words

program:
app "Ping pong" ball plum
table point team pick Left|Right, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Left)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Right)
setting winat num = 21 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Left" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Left, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Left, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Right" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Right, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Right, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Left win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Right win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Ping pong, in the plum colours.

- point: team: one of Left, Right; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Right, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Right, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.

  - text: "Left win!".

program:
app "Wedding Budget" gift ocean
table func name text, budget money
table expense func ref func, vendor text, amount money
table guest name text, side pick Bride|Groom, count num 1..20 = 1
when count(func, sum(it.expense.amount) > it.budget * 0.9) > 0 notify "A function passed 90 percent of its budget"
each func
  stack card gap 1
    row
      it.name head grow
      "left" it.budget - sum(it.expense.amount) bold color if(sum(it.expense.amount) > it.budget * 0.9, warn, good)
    goal sum(it.expense.amount), it.budget, "spent"
    each it.expense
      row
        it.vendor grow
        it.amount
form func, "Add function"
form expense, "Add expense"
"Guests" head
each guest by side
  stack card
    it.key sum(it.count) bold
    each it
      it.name
form guest, "Add guest"
describe:
Wedding Budget, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- func: name: text; budget: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- expense: func: a func; vendor: text; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- guest: name: text; side: one of Bride, Groom; count: number, 1 to 20, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- when how many of the func have the total amount of its expense entries is more than its budget times 0.9 is more than 0, it shows the notice "A function passed 90 percent of its budget".
- for each func:

program:
app "Salon products" star mint
table product_s name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 2, price money?
state q text = ""
let short = count(product_s, it.qty <= it.low)
short "products running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each product_s where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(product_s, it.qty * it.price) faint
form product_s
remind "Check your products" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Salon products, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- product s: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 2; price: money, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the product s have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "products running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each product s where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the product s for editing; a swipe removes the product s, with undo:
    - text: the name of the product s.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the product s to the qty of the product s minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the product s.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the product s to the qty of the product s plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the product s.
- a form to add a product s.
Reminder "Check your products" at 9:00 on Sat.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one

app "Follow-ups" heart mint
table patient name text, phone text?
table followup patient ref patient, due date, reason text?, done bool
remind "Patient follow-up due" at followup.due
count(followup where done = no and due <= today) "follow-ups due" head color if(count(followup where done = no and due <= today) > 0, warn, good)
